# Feature: LiveAct Golden Reference VRM (ARKit52)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-25 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Add one known-good external VRM 1.0 avatar with full ARKit52 expressions as a **diagnostic Golden Reference** selectable under Human Vorlage, so MediaPipe → LiveAct → VRM can be compared against SagaDrive Human assets without changing authoring/Meshy/QtMesh/retarget.

## Preconditions
- Character Editor, Vorlage anpassen → Mensch selected, gender set
- Reference binary present at allowlisted public path (via fetch script) OR check uses expression fixture
- Same LiveAct engine / VrmLiveActAvatarOutput as SagaDrive Human

## Happy Path
- [ ] Human Vorlage select: `SagaDrive Human` | `Reference VRM (ARKit52)`
- [ ] Reference resolves deterministically to pinned VALID VRM path (no Meshy/QtMesh/VRM-pack)
- [ ] Reference loads as VRM through existing CharacterStudioRuntime + VrmLiveActAvatarOutput
- [ ] No manual Face Mapping required for initial LiveAct drive
- [ ] Capability Inspector shows channel support; gaze path is single (`lookAt` expected for this asset)
- [ ] RAW vs APPLIED diagnostics remain available
- [ ] Switching back to SagaDrive Human restores prior species template mesh resolution

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Reference binary missing → clear load error / fail closed (no silent fallback to Meshy)
- [ ] Reference selection is diagnostic — must not become default product human
- [ ] Persist/save does not silently bake third-party reference URL as normal character identity (session override or strip on save)
- [ ] No `if (filename === …)` / TLTMedia / reference-id hacks in LiveAct retarget/expression mapping

## Regression
- [ ] SagaDrive Human male/female URLs unchanged
- [ ] Other species templates unchanged
- [ ] Expand drive bind / face overlay paths unchanged
